name: contract-static-before-visual
goal: Keep generated app static audit failures visible before mandatory screenshot baseline admission

evidence: Mandatory screenshot comparison now stops a fresh generated app check at missing baselines before audit. The existing ecosystem app case expects svelte-script-lang and fails at d26e0fdbea; direct audit still reports it.

The app generator case checked only that audit appeared in the script, not its position. Strengthen that same case with static-gate ordering and retain all rules in the existing disposable app violation case. Counts and titles stay fixed.
